description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the launcher activity for an app demonstrating media effects. It manages UI fragments, options menu, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android launcher activity that initializes UI components, manages fragment transactions, menu interactions, and sets up logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds MediaEffectsFragment if first creation.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling visibility and titles based on log display state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection; toggles log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain integrating with Android's log system and UI fragment.
